inventory.summary: The inventory of the codebase revealed no instances of quantum-vulnerable cryptography. A deterministic scan identified a potential non-constant-time comparison, which was adjudicated as a false positive (related to Macintosh file formats and macros, not cryptography). Subsequent manual searches for cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, mbedTLS, etc.), primitives (RSA, ECDH, X25519), and general security-related keywords confirmed the absence of cryptographic assets.
